resumos: A proxy server that forwards MCP requests to other MCP servers, enabling complex routing and load balancing in a distributed search environment.
A proxy tool designed to aggregate multiple Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into a single endpoint for AI agents to access.
Proxy ou gateway local para expor APIs do Elasticsearch (ou outro backend) via MCP, permitindo acesso offline.
A hypothetical MCP-compatible proxy layer for aggregating search results from multiple backends (e.g., CouchDB + local index).
